text:
jane_cust: Hey — Console shows "7 free trial days remaining" on our account summary but our API calls are still being billed. We hit a spike and it's consuming credits from invoice + showing usage charges. Is this a UI-only thing or are credits not applying to API?

support_matt: Sorry you're seeing that, can you paste your account id and an example request_id from a billed call?

jane_cust: account_id: acct_01X7ABCD, request_id: req_202603170945_9fb2. I saw a meter event in the console UI that says "trial_grant_2026-03-16" applied.

billing-bot: [automated] grant applied: grant_id=grant_trial_01X, account=acct_01X7ABCD, amount=7_days, target=console_summary, created=2026-03-16T18:22:10Z

support_matt: thanks. tagging @billing_anna and @devex_lee to investigate mapping of that grant to API meter tags.

billing_anna: looking now. Quick question — did the customer create sub-accounts/orgs under that account recently? Grants sometimes apply to the root org and not propagate to sub-org meters.

jane_cust: no sub-orgs, single team, created last month.

billing_anna: ok. I'm checking the grant record... it shows target_scope = "ui:summary" instead of "meter:api". That explains why Console shows it but the usage pipeline didn't pick it up.

devex_lee: is that a data entry bug from the support portal or an automated grant service mapping gone wrong? Any way to repro?

billing_anna: looks like a regression in the grant-service deployment on 2026-03-16 — a schema change accidentally defaulted target_scope to a UI alias. I can run a backfill to tag existing grants correctly. Estimated impact: affected ~120 accounts created between 2026-03-15 and 2026-03-17.

support_matt: what's the mitigation for this customer now? They already got billed for the spike.

billing_anna: immediate mitigation: I will trigger a resync for acct_01X7ABCD which will reprocess grants and issue a credit memo for any charged usage covered by the trial. It will also annotate the usage records with grant_id so future invoices reflect zero cost until trial exhausted. ETA for resync + credit: ~45 minutes.

jane_cust: thanks — can you also confirm how to reproduce the issue so I can avoid it?

devex_lee: repro steps for internal tracking: 1) create a trial grant via the grant-service UI with API payload missing scope field, 2) observe grant record defaulting to target_scope="ui:summary" in grants DB, 3) call /v1/usage?account=acct_... — usage pipeline ignores grant. Example curl to inspect current usage/credits:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/usage?account=acct_01X7ABCD&start=2026-03-15&end=2026-03-17"
# look for meter events and grant_id fields
```

devex_lee: I'll add a unit test to the grant-service to require explicit target_scope and a guard that prevents defaulting to UI alias.

billing_anna: resync kicked off for acct_01X7ABCD. Job id: resync-20260317-772. It will update usage records and enqueue a credit memo if overcharged.

billing-bot: [automated] resync job started: id=resync-20260317-772, account=acct_01X7ABCD, submitted_by=billing_anna, started_at=2026-03-17T10:02:12Z

support_matt: we'll follow up here when credit posts. @jane_cust — sorry for the outage, we'll refund any incorrect charges. :pray:

jane_cust: appreciate the quick help. I'll wait for the confirmation.

billing-bot: [automated] resync job completed: id=resync-20260317-772, status=completed, corrected_charges=1, credit_amount=$42.75, completed_at=2026-03-17T10:40:05Z

billing_anna: credit memo created and applied. Invoice updated. Confirmed that future API calls now consume from trial grant; I validated by running the curl above and seeing usage records with grant_id=grant_trial_01X and cost=0 for covered tokens.

jane_cust: saw the credit. billing page shows $0 now. Thanks everyone!

support_matt: closing the incident but I'll add a short postmortem note and tag eng-release to roll the hotfix to production to prevent reoccurrence.
